title: Research: share rank-eight output delta across dirty accumulators
body:
## Result

Adds a bounded recursive-interface construction package for paired dirty scalar outputs. If a rank-eight additive child computes `f(x,y)=sum(i=0..7) x_i*y_i`, then repeating

```text
NEG(D1); ADD(D2,D1); NEG(D1); child_plus(D1); ADD(D2,D1)
```

twice maps arbitrary `(D1,D2)` to `(D1+2f,D2+2f)`. It replaces four same-input rank-eight child calls by two, using four ADDs and four NEGs and no additional temporary. The affine map is checked symbolically over the integers and on 589,824 finite source/dirty-target cases; two omission controls fail.

## Cost and limits

At the selected complex endpoint, exact rational outward enclosures give baseline lower `4 phi_8 > 0.4399830566696027` and candidate upper `2 phi_8 + 8 phi_1 < 0.3303711890451098`, charging each added scalar gate one rank-one recursive unit. This is a scoped local mechanism and explicit surrogate cost screen. It does not establish that a selected supplier exposes the additive dirty-target contract, that the scalar-gate surrogate is its admitted price, that precision/tape bounds fit, or that the selected recursive profile or kappa improves.

This is distinct from PR #1410, which retains all ten children while persisting an order-four phase, and PR #1522, which shares a BIT source tour across outputs. The local Discussion claim could not be posted because GitHub GraphQL was rate-limited; the exact local claim and latest overlap status are in `CLAIM.md`.

## Reproduction and verification

From repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/dirty-output-delta-seed-b9eac2/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-output-delta-seed-b9eac2 --check-only
make selected-record-check
```

All three passed locally on Python 3.14.7. The full research-package wrapper expects Python 3.12, which is unavailable in this environment; that replay and hosted CI remain pending. Source manifest pins the exact selected record, assembly, predecessor interface context, and rational-enclosure helper to base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for scoping, algebra, implementation, exact verification, source handling, and exposition.
